method: Fresh onefile process/extraction per command, empty PATH/PYTHONPATH, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, 20ms process-tree memory sampling; OS file cache not flushed; concurrent audio soak active; no audio/UI invocation.

runs.stdout:
usage: textris.exe [-h] [--version] [--no-sound] [--ascii | --unicode]
                   [--theme {cathedral,cyberpunk,space,fire,crt,mono}]
                   [--seed SEED] [--data-dir DATA_DIR] [--audio-check]
                   [--verify-audio-assets]

TEXTRIS - keyboard-driven terminal Tetris

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --no-sound            mute this session
  --ascii               ASCII-safe text and art
  --unicode             enable Unicode art (requires a suitable terminal font)
  --theme {cathedral,cyberpunk,space,fire,crt,mono}
                        visual theme for this session
  --seed SEED           reproducible piece sequence
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   settings, records and generated audio directory
  --audio-check         test packaged audio playback and report output state,
                        then exit
  --verify-audio-assets
                        verify packaged soundtrack/effect inventory and
                        hashes, then exit
